## Iris dataset GLM
```{r}
head(iris)
```


```{r}
#must specify family of the GLM - it defaults to Gaussian/normal, which is a regular linear model
glm(Sepal.Length~Sepal.Width, data=iris) #output is a regulat linear model
glm(Sepal.Length~Sepal.Width, data=iris, family="Gamma") #output is a Gamma glm
```
```{r}
summary(glm(Sepal.Length~Sepal.Width, data=iris, family="Gamma")) #p-value for sepal width is not significant
```
